persona.name: Yvette Armstrong
persona.description: A 64-year-old Eastern European American woman recently diagnosed with Stage II hypertension and uncontrolled type 2 diabetes. Works full-time as a state employee with an associate's degree in political science. Curious and earnest but feels overwhelmed by complex medical information. Reports confusion about the difference between sodium and salt, struggles to understand the pathophysiology of her conditions, and expresses frustration about the difficulty of making dietary changes. BMI is 34 with a history of hypertension and type 2 diabetes. She is motivated to improve her health but faces barriers related to health literacy, financial constraints, limited time for cooking, and emotional stress from balancing full-time work with growing family responsibilities.
persona.residence: Urban suburban area with limited green space
persona.cultural_context: Grew up in a household where food was central to gatherings and celebrations. Traditional Eastern European dishes are often high in processed meats, cheese, and salt for preservation and flavor. She feels that cutting out traditional foods would mean losing a connection to her heritage and family bonds.
persona.personality: Curious, earnest, and eager to learn but easily overwhelmed by technical jargon and lengthy explanations. Values honesty and direct communication. Tries hard to comply but becomes frustrated when changes feel too difficult or unsustainable.
persona.communication_style: Asks clarifying questions when confused. May hesitate to ask if she feels she is burdening the provider. Responds well to patient, respectful, and non-judgmental communication. Uses lay terms and needs concepts explained simply with examples.
persona.support_system: Married with supportive husband who lives with her. Two adult children who live locally and visit regularly. One grandchild. Husband drives her to appointments. Family often pressures her to eat traditional foods at gatherings.
persona.readiness_to_change: Moderately motivated (Stage of Change: Preparation) but feels overwhelmed by the scale of changes required. Responds well to small, manageable steps and clear, simple explanations. Needs validation and step-by-step guidance.

settings.encounter_goal: Nutrition assessment and counseling (Nutrition Care Process)

faculty_brief.background: Full-time state employee with an associate’s degree in political science
faculty_brief.notes: Recently diagnosed with Stage II hypertension (BP 155/110 mmHg), Yvette struggles to understand medical explanations and is confused about sodium and salt. BMI is 34. "My doctor told me, but I just didn’t understand what she said. She needs clear education on what hypertension is, the role of sodium in blood pressure control, sodium limits, and the benefits of modest weight loss.
